import json,urllib.request
root="https://app.ontrackegy.com/saas/mobile/updates/"
def fetch(path,method="GET"):
 req=urllib.request.Request(root+path,method=method,headers={"Cache-Control":"no-cache","User-Agent":"OnTrack-Voice-Release-V25-Smoke"})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=10) as response:
  assert response.status==200
  return json.loads(response.read(65536)) if method=="GET" else dict(response.headers)
m=json.loads(fetch("native/latest.json")["payload"])
assert m["version_code"]==25 and m["version_name"]=="0.3.4-ota",m
assert m["sha256"]=="12dd448f45132050cc9f6374a640c6613e02d6d6f1abc6518ca7b8a099da14ed"
assert m["size"]==55065286
h=fetch("native/"+m["file"],"HEAD")
assert int(h.get("Content-Length",0))==m["size"],h
ui=json.loads(fetch("latest.json")["payload"])
assert ui["revision"]==21,ui
u=fetch(ui["file"],"HEAD")
assert int(u.get("Content-Length",0))==ui["size"]
print(json.dumps({"status":"public_http_verified","native_version":m["version_name"],"version_code":m["version_code"],"apk_http":200,"apk_bytes":m["size"],"apk_sha256":m["sha256"],"apk_file":m["file"],"ota_revision":ui["revision"],"ota_http":200,"ui_http":200}))
